buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE 25% : The buyer can increase or decrease the contract quantity or contract duration up to 25 percent at the time of issue of the contract. However, once the contract is issued, the contract quantity or contract duration can only be increased up to 25 percent. Bidders are bound to accept the revised quantity or duration. For lumpsum-based service contracts, the buyer may increase the scope of work and contract value up to 25 percent with the consent of the service provider 2. Forms of EMD and PBG Bidders can also submit the EMD with Fixed Deposit Receipt made out or pledged in the name of A/C FA & CAO MLG NFR . The bank should certify on it that the deposit can be withdrawn only on the demand or with the sanction of the pledgee. For release of EMD, the FDR will be released in the favour of the bidder by the Buyer after

making endorsement on the back of the FDR duly signed and stamped along with covering letter. Bidder has to upload scanned copy/ proof of the FDR along with bid and has to ensure delivery of hardcopy to the Buyer within 5 days of Bid End date/ Bid Opening date 3. Certificates Bidder's offer is liable to be rejected if they don't upload any of the certificates / documents sought in the Bid document, ATC and Corrigendum if any. 4. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses 1. The ambulance shall be a Type-B (Patient Transport Vehicle) AC ambulanc e van of similar model and make as specified in the Bid Details. 2. Upon finalization of bids, the successful bidder shall submit a self-attested copy of the RC of the vehicle, of the similar model and make, within the tim eline prescribed by the buyer. If the RC is not available at the time of biddin g, the bidder shall give an undertaking that, if the bid is finalized in his favo ur, he shall provide a vehicle as per the terms and conditions of the bid and submit its RC within the prescribed timeline. Failure to do so shall make the bidder liable for action as per the GeM Service STC, including cancellation o f the contract. 3. The air-conditioning system, medical equipment and all fittings shall be in working condition at all times. Maintenance records shall be produced on d emand. 4. Once the proof of vehicle has been accepted, any replacement with a new er Type-B ambulance shall be permitted only with prior written approval of the Railway Administration. 5. The ambulance shall be available 24×7, including Sundays and holidays, w ithout interruption. 6. Response time shall not exceed 10 minutes within station limits and 20 mi nutes for outstation deployment. Delay beyond this shall attract penalty as per the GeM Service STC. 7. The ambulance shall ordinarily be stationed at DRH/NBQ, and the Railway Administration may deploy it anywhere within its jurisdiction. It shall attend referral cases to Maligaon/Guwahati or any other designated hospital, as de cided by the attending Medical Officer. 8. The ambulance shall be manned at all times by a qualified driver with a va lid driving license and ambulance driving experience, in uniform provided b y the Service Provider. The Service Provider shall submit a pool of drivers w ith license copy, photo ID and photographs. 9. Any change of driver shall be intimated in writing to MS/IC/NBQ and prior a pproval obtained before deployment. Any misconduct, negligence, intoxication, refusal of duty or refusal to follow lawful instructions shall resu lt in immediate replacement by the Service Provider, without prejudice to p enalties. 10. The words "ON MEDICAL DUTY / N.F. RAILWAY" and "AMBULANCE" shall be prominently displayed on the front and rear of the vehicle.

11. The Railway Administration shall be indemnified and held harmless against all liabilities, claims and damages arising from accidents or untoward incide nts during ambulance operations. 12. The Railway Administration may terminate the contract by giving one mon th's notice without assigning any reason. No compensation shall be payable , and risk purchase may be resorted to at the cost and risk of the defaulting Service Provider. 13. The bidder shall upload, along with the bid documents, the declaration/cer tificate in the prescribed “Format for Certificate to be Submitted / Uploaded by Bidder along with the Bid Documents”, duly filled, signed and sealed by the authorized signatory, on the bidder’s company letterhead. Bids without this declaration in the prescribed format and on the company letterhead sh all be summarily rejected. . 5. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer uploaded ATC document Click here to view the file. 6. Purchase Preference (Centre) Purchase preference to Micro and Small Enterprises (MSEs): Purchase preference will be given to MSEs as defined in Public Procurement Policy for Micro and Small Enterprises (MSEs) Order, 2012 dated 23.03.2012 issued by Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises and its subsequent Orders/Notifications issued by concerned Ministry. If the bidder wants to avail the Purchase preference, the bidder must be the manufacturer of the offered product in case of bid for supply of goods. Traders are excluded from the purview of Public Procurement Policy for Micro and Small Enterprises. In respect of bid for Services, the bidder must be the Service provider of the offered Service. Relevant documentary evidence in this regard shall be uploaded along with the bid in respect of the offered product or service. If L-1 is not an MSE and MSE Seller (s) has/have quoted price within L-1+ 15% of margin of purchase preference /price band defined in relevant policy, such Seller shall be given opportunity to match L-1 price and contract will be awarded for percentage of 100% of total value. 7.
